title: You Can’t Eat Your Cake and Have It Too: The Performance Degradation of LLMs with Jailbreak Defense
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the trade-off between LLM safety (jailbreak defense) and performance (utility and usability) through a new benchmark called USEBench. While it discusses the refusal of harmful content and includes a section on the ethical considerations of its own research methods, it does not benchmark religious content, formal moral reasoning frameworks, or specific ethical philosophies.
